title: So glad I finally found this community
content: Ok so I definitely can resonate with the Mall World dreams...it's something Ive obsessed over for a long time but never really understood, just have kinda kept to myself in a lot of ways Found this page because I saw a post about having dreams regarding water parks or amusement parks - I vividly remember this only because I never could fully understand the significance behind it, but to this day I still vividly recall the very first dream I ever remember having, in retrospect I was still too young to actually have a good idea of what a water park was but had at least one or two vivid, lucid visual dreams revolving around a water park. Since then I've had all sorts of strange liminal-type dreams revolving around settings like this - not all the time, it might be a few weeks in between the really vivid ones - but yeah. I've had dreams in food courts where you can sort of recognize the people around you as familiar, dreams where you ride chrome escalators back and forth across a wide concourse, even stranger are dreams where you feel like you're in between two pockets of time - a shop along your way turns out to be a store you went to as a young child, but no longer exists. The more I read, the more fascinated I get.
